$comment: GPU classes for the hardware tier (rendering-pipeline.md section 2.3). Case-insensitive regular expressions tested against the adapter description (WebGPU adapter info, else the WEBGL_debug_renderer_info string). Evaluated in the order ultra, discrete, integrated; the first match wins. No match: vendorFallback by adapter vendor, else class 'unknown' (treated as Tier B). ultra = RTX 4070+ / RX 7800+ desktop; discrete = Tier A; integrated = Tier B.
